"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/jump-game-vi/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

1696. Jump Game VI

You are given a 0-indexed integer array nums and an integer k.

You are initially standing at index 0. In one move, you can jump at most k steps forward without going outside the boundaries of the array. That is, you can jump from index i to any index in the range [i + 1, min(n - 1, i + k)] inclusive.

You want to reach the last index of the array (index n - 1). Your score is the sum of all nums[j] for each index j you visited in the array.

Return the maximum score you can get.

Example 1:

Input: nums = [1,-1,-2,4,-7,3], k = 2
Output: 7
Explanation: You can choose your jumps forming the subsequence [1,-1,4,3] (underlined above). The sum is 7.

Example 2:

Input: nums = [10,-5,-2,4,0,3], k = 3
Output: 17
Explanation: You can choose your jumps forming the subsequence [10,4,3] (underlined above). The sum is 17.

Example 3:

Input: nums = [1,-5,-20,4,-1,3,-6,-3], k = 2
Output: 0

Constraints:

    1 <= nums.length, k <= 10^5
    -10^4 <= nums[i] <= 10^4
"""


class Solution:
    def maxResult(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        from collections import deque

        n = len(nums)
        dq = (
            deque()
        )  # will store indices of nums, values in decreasing order of dp values
        dp = [0] * n
        dp[0] = nums[0]
        dq.append(0)

        for i in range(1, n):
            # Remove indices out of window
            while dq and dq[0] < i - k:
                dq.popleft()
            # dp[i] = nums[i] + dp[dq[0]] because dq[0] has max dp value in window
            dp[i] = nums[i] + dp[dq[0]]
            # Maintain decreasing order in dq for dp values
            while dq and dp[i] >= dp[dq[-1]]:
                dq.pop()
            dq.append(i)

        return dp[-1]


sol = Solution()

print(sol.maxResult([1, -1, -2, 4, -7, 3], 2))  # 7

assert sol.maxResult([1, -1, -2, 4, -7, 3], 2) == 7
assert sol.maxResult([10, -5, -2, 4, 0, 3], 3) == 17
assert sol.maxResult([1, -5, -20, 4, -1, 3, -6, -3], 2) == 0

assert sol.maxResult([0], 1) == 0
assert sol.maxResult([-10000], 1) == -10000
assert sol.maxResult([10000], 1) == 10000
assert sol.maxResult([1, 1, 1, 1, 1], 1) == 5
assert sol.maxResult([1, 1, 1, 1, 1], 5) == 5
assert sol.maxResult([10, -10, 10, -10, 10, -10, 10], 2) == 40
assert sol.maxResult([-1, -2, -3, -4, -5], 3) == -8
assert sol.maxResult([i if i % 2 == 0 else -i for i in range(1000)], 10) == 248501
assert sol.maxResult([10000] * 100000, 100000) == 1000000000
assert sol.maxResult([-10000] * 100000, 100000) == -20000
assert sol.maxResult([0] * 100000, 1) == 0
assert sol.maxResult([1, -1] * 50000, 2) == 49999
